recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, warm-toned portrait featuring a female subject in bohemian attire, set against a bright, blown-out background with distressed, vintage-style paper textures at the edges. The composition uses a soft, hazy light source from the upper left to create a dreamlike atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's blonde hair blending into the high-key background light
Deep red embroidery and leather boots contrasting against cream-colored fabric
Textured, weathered borders framing a clean, luminous center
Right-aligned typography balanced by the subject's left-leaning pose
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadow detail
Subject seated in a relaxed, grounded pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, seated, scaled to show head to mid-calf.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright light flare behind the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the hair down to the red boots, then moves right to the typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white/cream negative space on the right side to accommodate text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep russet red (embroidery, boots, and text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow (hair highlights and lens flare)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), punctuated by high-saturation red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit black to eye makeup only

letterConstructionRules: Upper line uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with circular 'O's and 'C's
Lower line uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals and wide tracking
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, modern sans-serif and a traditional, wide-tracked serif.
graphicDevices: Distressed paper texture overlay on edges

preserve: Wide tracking on the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set sans-serif style of the top line
Matches the wide, high-contrast serif style of the bottom line

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a blonde woman in a cream bohemian tunic with red embroidery, seated on a white floor. Apply a warm, hazy light flare from the top left. Add a subtle, weathered paper texture vignette around the edges of the frame, leaving the center bright and clean.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned text in the upper right quadrant. The top line should be a wide geometric sans-serif in deep red. The bottom line should be a wide-tracked, high-contrast serif in the same deep red color.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and warm?
Is the text right-aligned in the negative space?
Are the red accents in the clothing and text consistent?
Is the border texture visible but not distracting?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the borders
Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's hair blends naturally with the light source
Check that the red text is legible against the bright background
Verify the distressed border does not overlap the subject's face
Confirm the pose feels relaxed and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, warm-toned lifestyle portrait with a textured vintage border and clean, right-aligned two-tier typography in a contrasting deep red.
